title: Source ecology v2 and cross-domain Answerable Power regression
question: Can the frozen 96-route global circulation denominator meet its route, content, basin, and classification contract without denominator manipulation or access bypass, and can the resulting source ecology support an honest regression of APC-01 across the five Sprint 03 domains?

repair_legs.name: Global GDELT serialization
repair_legs.problem: Parallel basin jobs generated rate-limit failures against one shared service.
repair_legs.intervention: Route all GDELT requests through one host gate with a minimum interval, bounded retries, Retry-After support, and deterministic routing back to the original basin records.
repair_legs.falsifier: The serialized tide still produces equivalent rate limiting or alters the frozen route semantics or denominator.

repair_legs.name: Authoritative fallback chains
repair_legs.problem: Bot-protected or client-rendered homepages fail despite the existence of official APIs, feeds, repositories, search pages, sitemaps, or lawful metadata routes.
repair_legs.intervention: Try explicit official fallbacks in order and preserve every attempt. Metadata fingerprints improve route health only and never count as content.
repair_legs.falsifier: The apparent gain comes from mirrors of uncertain authority, error pages, access-control bypass, or counting metadata as content.

repair_legs.name: Unhealthy-basin repair
repair_legs.problem: MENA, South Asia, and Oceania/Pacific remained below the frozen basin health contract.
repair_legs.intervention: Add official document, judgment, audit, archive, procurement, and replacement-host fallbacks while preserving all original routes and failure records.
repair_legs.falsifier: A basin becomes healthy only by deleting difficult sources, reducing source diversity, or changing its denominator.

repair_legs.name: Host-aware transport and size policy
repair_legs.problem: Timeouts, oversized pages, DNS failures, redirects, and gateway errors were handled too uniformly.
repair_legs.intervention: Apply bounded host intervals, timeout profiles, maximum-byte profiles, safe redirect handling, HTTPS downgrade refusal, and stable failure taxonomy.
repair_legs.falsifier: The policy hides failures, permits unbounded downloads, or weakens access and privacy controls.

repair_legs.name: Proof-bound orbit receipt
repair_legs.problem: Infrastructure completion can be confused with source health or evidentiary sufficiency.
repair_legs.intervention: Emit route observations, failure ledger, basin health, frozen route IDs, state separation, and checksum-bound receipt.
repair_legs.falsifier: The receipt can report healthy without satisfying the global and every-basin thresholds.

cross_domain_regression.observed_strength: R3/R4 judicial stay, burden shift, restoration, reconstruction, and compensation
cross_domain_regression.open_failure: ordinary automatic pause, R6 threshold governance, R7 affected-party value recovery, and successor durability

cross_domain_regression.observed_strength: R3/R4 arrest-practice restraint and system-level prohibition
cross_domain_regression.open_failure: pre-action person notice, complete technical access, deletion, compensation, R5, R6, R7, and nonrecurrence

cross_domain_regression.observed_strength: bounded R6 co-determination capable of disabling a monitoring function
cross_domain_regression.open_failure: individual rights floor, ordinary pre-update compliance, deletion, compensation, R5, R7, centralization and capture

cross_domain_regression.observed_strength: bounded R5 public build, migration, supplier exit, and continuing operation
cross_domain_regression.open_failure: independent long-run outcome, residual deletion, turnover durability, enterprise and component substitution, R6, and R7

cross_domain_regression.domain: public residual rights and value recovery
cross_domain_regression.observed_strength: TARP bounded R7 and target-sector public-equity or contingent-upside architectures
cross_domain_regression.open_failure: target-sector realization, affected-party distribution, cross-sector durability, and R6 linkage

every_domain_requires: direct voice or exact direct-voice deficit
